# Amalfi Coast Travel

> Independent travel guide for the Amalfi Coast, Sorrento Peninsula, and Gulf Islands (Capri, Ischia, Procida). Covers destinations, beaches, itineraries, practical transport, experiences, events, and blog articles. Available in 5 languages: English (en-us), Italian (it-it), French (fr-fr), German (de-de), Spanish (es-es). Updated for the 2025-2026 travel season. Features built-in fuzzy search across all content.

For the detailed reference with facts, distances, prices and transport info, see: https://amalficoast-travel.com/llms-full.txt

## Destinations — Amalfi Coast

- [Amalfi](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/amalfi/): Cathedral of Sant'Andrea, Piazza Duomo, paper mills, Arab-Norman history
- [Positano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/positano/): Iconic cliffside village, Spiaggia Grande, ceramic staircases, ferry connections
- [Praiano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/praiano/): Quieter alternative to Positano, Fiordo di Furore nearby, local life
- [Ravello](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/ravello/): Hilltop town, Villa Rufolo, Villa Cimbrone, Ravello Festival (classical music)
- [Maiori](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/maiori/): Longest beach on the coast, laid-back, fewer tourists
- [Minori](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/minori/): Roman villa ruins, limoncello production, local pastry scene
- [Vietri sul Mare](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/vietri-sul-mare/): Gateway to the Coast, famous for artistic ceramics
- [Cetara](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/amalfi-coast/cetara/): Fishing village, colatura di alici DOP, authentic gastronomic destination

## Destinations — Sorrento Peninsula

- [Sorrento](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/sorrento-peninsula/sorrento/): Main gateway town, ferry hub, limoncello, Piazza Tasso
- [Sant'Agnello](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/sorrento-peninsula/sant-agnello/): Residential neighbor of Sorrento, quieter base, sea views
- [Massa Lubrense](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/sorrento-peninsula/massa-lubrense/): Tip of the peninsula, Punta Campanella, hiking, views of Capri
- [Vico Equense](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/sorrento-peninsula/vico-equense/): Medieval cliff town, pizza by the metre, Aequa ruins

## Destinations — Gulf Islands

- [Capri](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/islands/capri/): Blue Grotto, Via Krupp, Monte Solaro, Faraglioni, luxury boutiques
- [Anacapri](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/islands/anacapri/): Upper town of Capri, Villa San Michele, Monte Solaro chairlift, Chiesa di San Michele
- [Ischia](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/islands/ischia/): Volcanic island, thermal spas, Aragonese Castle, Maronti beach, 5 communes
- [Forio](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/islands/forio/): Westernmost town on Ischia, La Mortella gardens, Soccorso church, Citara thermal beach
- [Procida](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/islands/procida/): Smallest Gulf island, pastel-colored Marina Corricella, Il Postino filming location, 2022 Capital of Culture

## Beaches — Amalfi Coast

- [Fiordo di Furore](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/amalfi-coast/fiordo-di-furore/): Dramatic fjord-like gorge beach, steep stairs or boat access
- [Spiaggia Grande Positano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/amalfi-coast/spiaggia-grande-positano/): Main beach of Positano, pebble/sand mix, ferry landing point
- [Santa Croce Amalfi](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/amalfi-coast/santa-croce-amalfi/): Hidden cove near Amalfi, boat or free shuttle access, crystal-clear water
- [Marina di Praia](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/amalfi-coast/marina-di-praia/): Small cove between cliffs in Praiano, diving spot

## Beaches — Sorrento Peninsula

- [Regina Giovanna](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/sorrentine-peninsula/regina-giovanna/): Natural pool inside Roman ruins, rocky access, free
- [Marina del Cantone](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/sorrentine-peninsula/marina-del-cantone/): Pebble beach, excellent seafood (Spaghetti alla Nerano), snorkeling
- [Cala di Mitigliano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/sorrentine-peninsula/cala-mitigliano/): Steep trail descent, best view of Capri from a beach, pristine water
- [Spiaggia di Ieranto](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/sorrentine-peninsula/spiaggia-di-ieranto/): FAI-protected bay, hiking access only, stunning Capri views

## Beaches — Gulf Islands

- [Marina Piccola Capri](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/islands/marina-piccola-capri/): Capri's main swimming area, La Canzone del Mare historic lido
- [Spiaggia dei Maronti](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/islands/spiaggia-maronti/): Ischia's longest beach (3 km), volcanic black sand, natural fumaroles
- [Cala del Pozzo Vecchio](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/islands/cala-del-pozzo-vecchio/): Procida beach from Il Postino (1994), volcanic black sand, uncrowded
- [Faraglioni Capri](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/beaches/islands/faraglioni-capri/): Iconic rock formations, swimming and boat excursions

## Experiences

- [Trekking & Path of the Gods](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/experiences/trekking/): Agerola to Nocelle, 7.5 km coastal trail, Ferriere Valley
- [Boat Tours](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/experiences/boat-tours/): Sea caves, secret coves, coastal panoramas from the water
- [Mozzarella Experience](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/experiences/mozzarella-experience/): Artisan cheesemaking, Provolone del Monaco DOP
- [Limoncello Tour](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/experiences/limoncello-tour/): Lemon groves of Amalfi, production process, tastings
- [Cooking Class](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/experiences/cooking-class/): Authentic Campanian cuisine with local chefs
- [Starred Restaurants](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/experiences/starred-restaurants/): Fine dining on the Amalfi Coast and Sorrentine Peninsula
- [Weddings](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/experiences/weddings/): Dream wedding venues on the Amalfi Coast

## Itineraries

- [1-day: Amalfi Coast from Naples](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/1-day/amalfi-coast-from-naples/): Day-trip by ferry or SITA bus, Positano-Amalfi-Ravello loop
- [1-day: Amalfi Coast from Salerno](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/1-day/amalfi-coast-from-salerno/): Day-trip starting from Salerno, ferry to Amalfi and Positano
- [1-day: Capri from Sorrento](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/1-day/capri-from-sorrento/): Early ferry, Blue Grotto, Monte Solaro, return by afternoon
- [1-day: Path of the Gods Trek](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/1-day/path-of-the-gods-trek/): Agerola to Nocelle, 7.5 km coastal trail, bus connections
- [1-day: Sorrentine Peninsula from Naples](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/1-day/sorrentine-peninsula-from-naples/): Sorrento, Massa Lubrense, Punta Campanella
- [3-day: Classic Amalfi Coast](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/3-days/classic-amalfi-coast/): Positano, Amalfi, Ravello, day-trip to Capri
- [3-day: Sorrento, Pompeii & History](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/3-days/sorrento-pompeii-history/): Sorrento base, Pompeii, Herculaneum, Vesuvius
- [3-day: Islands — Ischia & Procida](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/3-days/islands-ischia-procida/): Thermal baths, authentic Procida, island-hopping
- [7-day: Grand Tour Coast & Peninsula](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/7-days/grand-tour-coast-peninsula/): Full coast from Sorrento to Salerno, all main towns, Capri, Pompeii
- [7-day: Slow Travel Villages & Food](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/itineraries/7-days/slow-travel-villages-food/): Lesser-known villages, local markets, food producers

## Practical Guides

- [Getting Here](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/guide/getting-here/): Airports (Naples Capodichino), trains, buses, ferries to reach the Coast
- [When to Visit](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/guide/when-to-visit/): Seasons, climate, best time to visit, crowd levels
- [Ferries & Hydrofoils](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/guide/ferries/): Timetables, ports, operators (Caremar, SNAV, Alilauro, NLG)
- [SITA Bus](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/guide/sita-bus/): SS163 coastal road bus, ticket purchasing, crowding tips
- [Parking & ZTL](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/guide/parking-ztl/): Restricted traffic zones, paid parking options, car-free strategy

## Blog

- [Baia di Recommone](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/baia-recommone/): Hidden beach refuge between Nerano and Crapolla
- [Crapolla Fjord](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/fiordo-di-crapolla/): 700 ancient steps, medieval chapel, pristine beach
- [Punta Campanella](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/punta-campanella/): Where myth meets the two gulfs, Temple of Athena
- [Sorrento vs Praiano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/sorrento-vs-praiano/): Complete guide to choosing your home base
- [Sunset Beaches](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/sunset-beaches/): Best spots for golden hour on the Coast
- [Comfortable Beaches](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/comfortable-beaches/): Accessible, well-equipped beaches without steep stairs
- [Wild Remote Beaches](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/wild-remote-beaches/): Boat-only secret coves and hidden swimming spots
- [Emerald Grotto](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/emerald-grotto/): Complete guide to Conca dei Marini's sea cave
- [Amalfi Coast Wines](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/amalfi-coast-wines/): Heroic vineyards of Tramonti and Scala, DOC wines
- [Atrani](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/atrani/): Italy's smallest village, medieval alleys, Ripley filming location
- [Lemon Delight](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/lemon-delight/): History and secrets of the Delizia al Limone
- [Ferriere Valley](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/ferriere-valley/): Prehistoric ferns, waterfalls, medieval paper mill ruins
- [Cetara Anchovies](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/cetara-anchovies/): Colatura di alici DOP, heir to Roman Garum
- [Tiberius Gardens & Via Krupp](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/blog/tiberius-gardens-via-krupp/): Augustus Gardens, Via Krupp history, Villa Jovis on Capri

## Events

### Amalfi Coast Events
- [Ravello Festival](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/ravello-festival/): July-September, classical concerts on Villa Rufolo terrace
- [Festa di Sant'Andrea Amalfi](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/festa-sant-andrea-amalfi/): 27 June & 30 November, patron saint procession and fireworks
- [Fuochi di Ferragosto](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/fuochi-ferragosto-positano-maiori/): 14-15 August fireworks over Positano and Maiori
- [Sagra del Pesce Positano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/sagra-del-pesce-positano/): Fish festival on Fornillo beach
- [Luminaria San Domenico Praiano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/luminaria-san-domenico-praiano/): August, thousands of candles illuminating Praiano
- [Notte Blu Vietri](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/notte-blu-vietri/): Blue Night ceramics festival
- [Regata Storica Amalfi](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/regata-storica-amalfi/): Historic regatta of the Maritime Republics
- [Capodanno Bizantino](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/capodanno-bizantino/): Byzantine New Year celebration in Amalfi
- [Positano Mare Sole Cultura](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/positano-mare-sole-cultura/): Summer arts and culture festival
- [Festival del Limone Minori](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/festival-limone-minori/): Lemon festival in Minori
- [Festa San Gennaro Praiano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/amalfi-coast/festa-san-gennaro-praiano/): Patron saint celebration

### Island Events
- [Ischia Global Film Festival](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/islands/ischia-global-film-festival/): July, international cinema on the island
- [Sagra del Mare Graziella Procida](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/islands/sagra-del-mare-graziella-procida/): Sea festival and Graziella pageant
- [Anacapri Settembre al Borgo](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/islands/anacapri-settembre-borgo/): September cultural events in Anacapri

### Sorrento Peninsula Events
- [Festa di Sant'Antonino Sorrento](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/sorrento-peninsula/festa-sant-antonino/): Patron saint of Sorrento
- [Gustamincanto Vico Equense](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/sorrento-peninsula/gustamincanto-vico-equense/): Food and music festival
- [Madonna della Libera](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/sorrento-peninsula/madonna-della-libera/): Traditional religious celebration
- [Sagra del Limone Massa Lubrense](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/sorrento-peninsula/sagra-limone-massa-lubrense/): Lemon festival
- [Sagra della Melanzana Preazzano](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/sorrento-peninsula/sagra-melanzana-preazzano/): Eggplant festival
- [Sorrento Meeting Cultura](https://amalficoast-travel.com/en-us/events/sorrento-peninsula/sorrento-meeting-cultura/): Cultural meetings and events

Each section is fully translated. Use the locale prefix to access content:

- `/en-us/` — English
- `/it-it/` — Italian (most complete, includes all events and experiences)
- `/fr-fr/` — French
- `/de-de/` — German
